name: focus-flow-monitor
description: Master your online habits! Track time, visualize usage, block distractions, set limits, and enhance focus with the built-in Pomodoro (Tomato) timer.

scripts.build:beta: npm run clean && npm run update-manifests && webpack --mode production --env target=beta --progress
scripts.build:release: npm run clean && npm run update-manifests && webpack --mode production --env target=release --progress
scripts.check: npm run validate && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm test
